As per the revised 2024 criteria, which of the following is NOT a necessary feature for a language to be classified as classical?
options: Possession of a body of ancient literature/texts considered valuable heritage by generations.
Continuous everyday spoken use from ancient times to the present
Classical language and literature differ from modern forms, with possible breaks between the classical stage and later developments
Early texts and recorded history spanning 1,500–2,000 years.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Continuous everyday spoken use from ancient times to the present) है।

What do you mean by osmosis?
options: Water moving out of the cell, and the cell membrane of a plant cell shrinking away from its cell wall
The pressure exerted by the protoplasts due to entry of water against the rigid walls
The bulk movement of substances through the conducting or vascular tissues of plants
The diffusion of water across a differentially or selectively permeable membrane
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The diffusion of water across a differentially or selectively permeable membrane) है।

Which of the following is the main purpose of holding National Level Lok Adalats in India?
options: To dispose of pending cases through amicable settlement outside formal courts
To hear appeals from High Courts in specific civil and criminal matters
To train judges and lawyers in alternative dispute resolution mechanisms
To provide constitutional remedies to citizens through fast-track tribunals
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (To dispose of pending cases through amicable settlement outside formal courts) है।
